auditTarget: Forensic Security Findings and Remediation Assessment

defectRemediation.originalIssue: CanonicalDomainBindingEngine.sealBinding() was an unauthenticated public method permitting callers to issue authoritative seals without proving authority.
defectRemediation.proofOfRemediation: sealBinding now mandates authorityKey symbol matching engineKey via verifyAuthorityKey(). Unauthenticated calls throw SIMULATION_AUTHORITY_VIOLATION.

verifiedEnforcements: Solvers across PCB, Electrical, Harness, Multidomain, FEM, and CFD check validateBinding() and fail closed on unsealed or invalid bindings.
No literal string seals ('MD-SEAL', 'TEST-SEAL') remain in production source files.
All 8 security tests in AuthoritySealTrustBoundary.test.ts pass with strong assertions.
HMAC-SHA256 signature verification rejects forged seal tokens, geometry tampering, and revision tampering.

boundedResidualRisks.title: Public Export Access to getAuthorityBootKey()
boundedResidualRisks.description: getAuthorityBootKey() is exported from SimulationAuthorityInternal.ts without caller authentication or stack-frame inspection. Any module executing in the JS process memory space can import getAuthorityBootKey() and obtain the engine key symbol to seal bindings.
boundedResidualRisks.mitigationScope: Acceptable for single-process Node environment where module imports are governed by static build boundaries, but represents a key-exposure boundary risk.

boundedResidualRisks.title: Static Fallback Secret in computeHMACSealToken
boundedResidualRisks.description: computeHMACSealToken uses 'DEFAULT_SECP_AUTHORITY_SECRET' as a fallback if authoritySecretHMAC is null prior to boot initialization.
boundedResidualRisks.mitigationScope: Mitigated because initializeAuthorityHandshake() initializes authoritySecretHMAC upon first access, but fallback constant remains present in code.
